nodes.label: Behavioral Video Acquisition GUI
nodes.rationale: Replaces SpinView, which requires manual start/stop and post-hoc association of video files with animal metadata; this app binds metadata at write time and reduces per-trial interaction to a single keypress.

nodes.label: PDCT (Pole Descent Cognitive Test)
nodes.rationale: Rats descend a vertical pole; trials run 1-5 minutes, long relative to mouse PDCT, so every duration threshold is a config value rather than a literal.

nodes.label: CameraBackend Abstraction
nodes.rationale: Abstract interface reporting resolution, pixel_format, frame_rate, verify_settings and incomplete_frame_count so preflight can compare what the hardware actually does against what config intends.

nodes.label: MockCamera Backend
nodes.rationale: First-class, not a test double: the whole app must run and all tests must pass with zero hardware attached so development can happen away from the rig.

nodes.label: SpinnakerCamera Backend
nodes.rationale: Real hardware path via PySpin, deliberately built after the mock path was complete and tested.

nodes.label: Invariant 1 — N-Camera by Construction
nodes.rationale: Cameras come from a config list currently holding one entry; two more views (lateral, top-down) arrive later and must not force a refactor.

nodes.label: Invariant 2 — Mock Backend Is First-Class
nodes.rationale: Zero-hardware runnability is what makes an unattended build verifiable; it also forces `import PySpin` to stay inside methods rather than at module scope.

nodes.label: Invariant 3 — Capture Never Blocks
nodes.rationale: One capture thread per camera using Spinnaker's image event handler (not polling) feeding a bounded queue and a separate writer thread; on queue-full drop the frame, increment a counter and log, never block.

nodes.label: Invariant 6 — Hardware Timestamps Only
nodes.rationale: Chunk timestamps and frame IDs go to a per-trial CSV sidecar; host wall-clock arrival time is never substituted because future ephys alignment and 3D triangulation depend on camera-side time.

nodes.label: Invariant 7 — No Camera Configuration UI
nodes.rationale: Governs image-formation parameters (exposure, gain, ROI, gamma, trigger) that change what the science looks like; the app refuses to record against a wrongly-configured camera rather than silently fixing one. Carve-out: chunk data and transport-layer stream buffers are data-integrity settings the app owns and logs.

nodes.label: Invariant 8 — Trial Stop Is a Pluggable Predicate
nodes.rationale: Stop is keypress-driven today and pose-driven later, so it must never be welded into a Qt event handler.

nodes.label: Invariant 9 — Config Over Literals
nodes.rationale: Durations, thresholds, keymaps, paths and encoder settings all live in TOML so a second rig or a new paradigm needs no source change.

nodes.label: Trial State Machine (IDLE → RECORDING → IDLE)
nodes.rationale: min_trial_duration_s swallows double-tap zero-length trials; suspicious_duration_s auto-flags implausibly fast descents; max_trial_duration_s auto-stops so an animal that never descends cannot run away with the disk.

nodes.label: Pre-Roll Ring Buffer (2 s)
nodes.rationale: Runs whenever streaming, not just during trials, and is prepended on trial start so descent onset is never clipped by experimenter reaction time. ~23 MB per camera per 2 s at 720x540 Mono8 / 30 fps.

nodes.label: Reason-Code Hotkey Flagging
nodes.rationale: Every trial is valid by default and annotation is subtractive and never blocking; flags toggle, are not mutually exclusive, and target the recording trial if active else the most recent one so late annotation still works.

nodes.label: Preflight Checks
nodes.rationale: Config is not ground truth about hardware — it is intent; the backend reports actuals and preflight compares. Does not short-circuit on first failure so an experimenter with an animal in hand sees everything wrong in one pass. A 1280x720 config value meeting a 720x540 sensor silently sheared video with no error.

nodes.label: Encoder Tuning Lever Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Ordered by how much each actually matters: exposure time (motion blur destroys keypoint precision and no bitrate recovers it) > resolution/ROI > crf/qsv_global_quality > preset > codec choice. Measure with tools/measure_encoder.py rather than guessing; SSIM is only a proxy for keypoint accuracy.

nodes.label: Session Directory and Filename Convention
nodes.rationale: t<NNN> alone guarantees uniqueness; HHMM disambiguates repeat sessions on the same animal same day. The optional <view> token exists because DeepLabCut flattens folder structure on import, so filenames must stand alone.

nodes.label: Acquisition-Side Cross-Repo Contract
nodes.rationale: Any field name/type/meaning change requires updating shared/schema/ and the analysis repo's manifest stage in the same commit, plus a schema_version bump.

nodes.label: Storage Management and Transfer Staging
nodes.rationale: GB free is not actionable mid-session, so the readout is estimated remaining recording time from measured bitrate. Remote is a generic mounted path / rsync / robocopy target, never an institution-specific system. Purge requires explicit confirmation after verified transfer.

nodes.label: UserSet1 Camera Settings Profile
nodes.rationale: Camera-onboard profile configured in SpinView and loaded at startup; keeping image-formation settings on the camera rather than in the app is what makes invariant 7 enforceable.

nodes.label: Spinnaker Chunk Data (FrameID + Timestamp)
nodes.rationale: Per-frame metadata embedded by the camera; the app must enable ChunkModeActive and both chunks itself because the camera ships with them off and invariant 6 is otherwise unsatisfiable.

nodes.label: Checkpoint A9.5 — Camera Backend Schema
nodes.rationale: Rewrote the A9 plan against real hardware: backend self-reports geometry/format/rate, preflight asserts config against all of them, [camera_verify] table moves to config, HARDWARE.md records the measured camera.

nodes.label: Checkpoint A10 — SpinnakerCamera Implementation
nodes.rationale: Code complete and streaming (60 s / 3960 frames, zero drops); remaining failures all trace to one cause — UserSet1 still holds factory defaults — so verification is blocked on SpinView rig configuration, not on code.

nodes.label: Checkpoint A11 — Application Wiring (Composition Root)
nodes.rationale: Every part is built and tested but nothing outside tests constructs a camera, CaptureController, CameraRig or screen; app/__main__.py raises NotImplementedError. This composition root is what stands between the repo and lab use.
